open_points.subject: A09/A10 request building and approval digest headers
open_points.text: "The headers sent are exactly: `host` ..., `accept-encoding: identity`, the instance's required headers, the credential header, and, with a body, `content-type` and `content-length`"
open_points.question: What must the kernel do if `required_headers` includes one of these fixed headers (`host`, `accept-encoding`, `content-type`, `content-length`) with a different value or casing-normalized duplicate name?
options: Refuse the binding as manifest mismatch
Refuse send at runtime as pre-send check failure
Allow required header to override fixed header
open_points.default_guess: Refuse at proposal/accept time as manifest mismatch to avoid ambiguous wire request and request_digest.

open_points.subject: A08 manifest JSON validity for digest/pinning
open_points.text: "the service record is absent, is not valid JSON" and "`record_digest` is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of that one capability entry"
open_points.question: How are JSON objects with duplicate member names in manifest files handled when deciding "valid JSON" and computing `record_digest`?
options: Reject as manifest mismatch (treat duplicate names as invalid)
Accept parser result (last-key-wins) and hash that
Accept parser result (first-key-wins) and hash that
open_points.default_guess: Reject duplicate-member objects as manifest mismatch so digesting is deterministic across implementations.
